topic: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, the Tencent memory-writer model that runs locally
title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: a 30B that remembers
description: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B is Tencent's memory writer model. What it is, what it beats, and how it runs locally tonight. (working description; stage 05 overwrites)
hook_candidates: Eighteen gigabytes just beat Claude at remembering.
Your model isn't forgetful. Its memory was never written.
Tencent shipped a model that only remembers.
Fifty-five point four nine beats fifty-four point six two.
You chat. It forgets. That was the whole problem.
Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: the 30B that never talks to you.
A three-billion-active model just matched Claude's memory.
Stop paying Claude to take notes.
Your local model needs a secretary, not a bigger brain.
Thirty billion parameters for one job: remembering.
narration_full: Eighteen gigabytes just beat Claude at remembering. Tencent's Hy-Memory has one job. It writes what your assistant remembers. Your local model forgets you between chats. Frameworks like mem zero keep a memory bank, notes stored outside the model. A frontier model wrote those notes. Hy-Memory takes that job. It never chats; it decides what to keep and what to overwrite. On the memory tests it scores fifty-five point five percent. Claude Opus five scores fifty-four point six. Catch: the scores are Tencent's own. Half are statistical ties. The weights are free; that eighteen-gigabyte file runs tonight. Remembering stopped being a bigger brain. It's a small service beside the model you already run.
